name: ocs-books-preview
deploy_model: Direct Cloudflare API upload. The LIVE worker is the source of truth; this repo has no Workers Builds CI. After any change, redeploy the live worker and commit the new worker.js + metadata.json here.

secrets.APPSCRIPT_URL: optional - Apps Script /exec URL; enables the Sheet + email forward
secrets.APPSCRIPT_SECRET: optional - shared secret sent to Apps Script; must match Code.gs SHARED_SECRET
secrets.ALERT_WEBHOOK: optional - POST target for submission-failure alerts

kv_key_layout.first-edition.pdf: the free First-Edition PDF served at /read

version: v2 - dual-write (KV durable copy 1 + Apps Script Sheet/email copy 2), mutually backing; secret-gated KV export; graceful degradation when no secrets set
restore: PUT worker.js to /accounts/<acct>/workers/scripts/ocs-books-preview as multipart: metadata { main_module: 'worker.js', compatibility_date: '2024-11-01', bindings: [OCS_BOOKS above] } + a 'worker.js' part (Content-Type application/javascript+module). Always preserve existing bindings/secrets on redeploy. Verify the deployed source sha256 equals source_sha256.
